core.title: HES 5000 Series Sackable Lip Extensions, HES 5104x
tags: HES 5000 Series Electric Strike Lip Extensions

text.description_html:
HES 5000 Series Press Fit Stackable Lip Extensions

This is a Sackable Lip Extension for HES 5000 Series Electric Strikes. Choose from a 1/2 inch extension, a 1 inch extension, or a 1-1/4 inch extension. They can be stacked in any combination to achieve the lip length that you require. Easy to install, they just snap right on to a HES 5000 Series Strike.

Can Be Used With:
HES 5000DC630-501A, Low Profile Electric Strike for Cylindrical Locksets in Aluminum Frames or
HES 5000DC630-501, Low Profile Electric Strike for Cylindrical Locksets in ANSI Metal Jambs

Available in 3 Sizes:

    5104-1/2
    • 1/2" Stackable Lip Extension

    5104-1
    • 1" Stackable Lip Extension

    5104-1-1/4
    • 1-1/4" Stackable Lip Extension

Sold Individually
